statement.quantifiers: For every L in N0, every continuous real target on the order-L bofop-DIDM quotient, and every epsilon>0, there is an L-layer MPNN with uniform error below epsilon.
statement.domain: BF_d^r modulo zero order-L DIDM-mover distance
statement.model: the paper's MPNN class with continuous Lipschitz updates and readout

evidence_routes: source-anchored Tietze restriction of the ambient Theorem E.12, using only Theorem L.2 compactness and not its false strict-subset clause
constructive uniform interpolation for every continuous target on a continuum of bounded-fiber weighted sparse cycles
actual L=2 MPNN embeddings and trained readouts on held-out bounded-fiber sparse graphs from five families
an independent piecewise-linear readout construction that imports no primary verifier code
acceptance: the held-out maximum error for all three continuous targets is at most 0.04
the continuum target sweep reaches maximum error at most 0.01
the independent readout reaches the same 0.04 threshold
removing message passing and shifting training labels both miss the declared threshold
a discontinuous-target control is rejected with exact uniform error lower bound 1/2
every graph has essential-supremum fiber mass at most r=1
non_circularity: Targets, splits, sweeps, and thresholds are committed inputs. Width is selected by a first-hit sweep rather than a theorem-derived formula.
